Daniel Grover

Mechanical Engineer at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

I'm a mechanical engineering graduate from UC Berkeley with a strong passion for everything engineering entails - design, manufacturing, testing, integration, and teamwork. I enjoy working with my hands and tackling tricky problems. I have experience in project management, design, fabrication, CAD, FEA, and GD&T drawings.
